svg.aria-label: FIG. 1. What one holdout_decide call does. On the left, on paper, on your machine: the call with its weights, input and output; the orders, sells then buys, with gated buys dropped; the record, canonical JSON kept as records/<h>.json; and its sha256, h. A call with the same requestId is resumed and never sealed twice. At the seam, one transaction seals h, in amber: Lane.trade(h, legs), or Lane.seal(h, 0). On the right, on carbon, after the seal: the feed rounds that value the legs, all later than the seal, drawn as ticks; and, from the transaction, the record posted after the receipt to /r/<h>.json, and the decision on the board beside the house models.
svg.title: FIG. 1 one holdout_decide call
